bugs.name: Extensions Explore page renders an unexpected error
bugs.summary: The dashboard Extensions Explore route opens a full-page unexpected-error state and remains broken after Refresh page.
bugs.expected: Extensions Explore should show the available extension catalog.
bugs.actual: Opening /extensions/explore displays We’ve encountered an unexpected error with Dashboard and Refresh page buttons. Refresh page returns to the same error.
reproSteps: Sign in to Saleor and open Extensions > Explore, or navigate to /extensions/explore.
Observe the full-page unexpected-error state.
Click Refresh page; the same error returns.

bugs.name: Back action on manifest install page does not return to Installed extensions
bugs.summary: The bottom Back action on the manifest-install screen leaves the authenticated admin on the same form with the invalid URL and validation message, rather than returning to Installed. Reported variant: Clicking Back on the empty manifest installation form leaves the form open instead of returning to Installed extensions. Count this as the same reference rather than a separate bug.
bugs.expected: Using the visible Back action after navigating from Installed should return the admin to the installed extensions list at /extensions/installed, ending the manifest-install flow.
bugs.actual: After entering `not-a-valid-url` and blurring the field, the page showed “Invalid manifest URL.” Clicking the bottom Back action twice left the browser at /extensions/app/install with the entered value and validation message still visible, even after waiting and rechecking.
reproSteps: Navigate to /extensions/installed.
Click Add Extension, then select Install from manifest; the browser opens /extensions/app/install.
Enter `not-a-valid-url` in the Provide Manifest URL field, then blur the field and verify the visible “Invalid manifest URL” message.
Click the bottom Back action. Wait, click Back again, and verify that the URL remains /extensions/app/install and the invalid value and validation message remain visible.
Reported variant: Open /extensions/installed in the authenticated admin session (the provided authenticated session was used; no account identifier was supplied).
Reported variant: Click Add Extension, then choose Install from manifest.
Reported variant: On /extensions/app/install, leave the Provide Manifest URL field empty and click Back at the bottom right.
Reported variant: Observe that the manifest form remains open. Click Back again; it still remains open.
Reported variant: For a fresh-precondition check, click Installed in the Extensions sidebar, repeat Add Extension > Install from manifest, and click Back. The form remains open after settling.

reviewedVariants.name: Manifest installation form Back button does not navigate back
reviewedVariants.expected: After opening Install from manifest from Extensions > Installed, clicking Back should return to the Installed extensions screen at /extensions/installed.
reviewedVariants.actual: The click leaves the empty manifest form visible at /extensions/app/install. Repeated clicks, including a coordinate click, left the URL, empty field, and form unchanged; the state remained stable after waiting six seconds.

reviewedVariants.name: Back button does not leave blank manual extension form
reviewedVariants.summary: The blank manual extension form remains open after two clicks on its Back button, forcing navigation through the Installed sidebar link to exit.
reviewedVariants.expected: Clicking Back on the unsaved manual-add form should leave the form and return to Extensions > Installed, where the flow began.
reviewedVariants.actual: After two clicks, the blank form remained visible at /extensions/custom/add. Clicking Installed in the sidebar then returned to the installed extensions list.
reproSteps: Use an authenticated admin session; no credentials were entered during this run.
Open /extensions/installed and wait for Extensions > Installed to load.
Click Add Extension, then choose Provide details manually.
Leave the extension name and permissions blank, then click Back at the bottom of the form.
Click Back a second time. The blank manual-add form remains visible at /extensions/custom/add.
Click Installed in the Extensions sidebar to return to the installed extensions list. Do not click Save.

bugs.name: The manual extension form's permission description has ungrammatical copy: “access certain part of Saleor system.”
bugs.summary: The manual extension form's permission description has ungrammatical copy: “access certain part of Saleor system.”
bugs.expected: The helper text should use grammatically correct phrasing, such as “access certain parts of the Saleor system.”
bugs.actual: The visible helper text reads “Expand or restrict extension permissions to access certain part of Saleor system.”
reproSteps: /extensions/installed
Open Extensions > Installed as an administrator.
Click Add Extension and choose Provide details manually.
Read the sentence beneath Permissions: “Expand or restrict extension permissions to access certain part of Saleor system.”
